title: What We Check Before a WordPress.org Submission
description: A short overview of the practical checks we run before preparing a WordPress plugin submission.
metaDescription: A practical overview of the checks we run before preparing a WordPress.org plugin submission.
intro: Before submitting a plugin, we focus on a small set of checks that reduce avoidable review friction and make the release easier to maintain.

items.title: Plugin basics and packaging
items.body: We review plugin headers, versioning, stable tag, readme structure, assets, and packaging details so the submission is clean before it reaches review.

items.title: Security and admin hygiene
items.body: We check sanitization, escaping, nonce usage, capability checks, and whether admin-side behavior stays focused and predictable.

items.title: Maintenance and uninstall behavior
items.body: We verify activation behavior, uninstall expectations, and whether the plugin leaves behind anything that would make long-term maintenance messy.
